raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the experimental design by treating the manipulated factor (speed) as the dependent variable. In this setup, speed is the independent (manipulated) variable and the jump outcome is the dependent variable. This led to selecting the wrong option and even mismatching the option letter, and the agent prematurely marked the task complete without validation.
